simulator.note: Boots as an M3602A board (chips/m3602.py, lemontree_decoder.py, run_dump_synaps_galaxy_x7_1518_app_starts.py, run_dump_synaps_galaxy_x7_1518_capture_screen.py): the "M3602A 1.1.6" bootloader communicates with the external Lemontree EuP standby and PT6311 8-character 14-segment VFD microcontroller at I2C 0x28 on bit-banged SCL = GPIO 62 / SDA = GPIO 171 using 8-byte CRC-16/XMODEM frames (updating the 8-character VFD "  BOOT  " -> "        " -> "   ON   "), prints "APP  init ok", unpacks maincode(AV) (7.05 MB) to 0x80008000, and starts the single-CPU application.  The application configures the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33 and Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60 on SCB0 / SCB1, initialises hs_config_init over SPI, and renders its Synaps Galaxy OSD dialog through GeM3602.

desc: Opticum / Globo HD X7 Combo (System ID 06000200) firmware 1.5.18 with the Synaps Galaxy GUI and dual remote table (new + old remote, 2012-10-16) on a 4 MB SPI flash for the ALi M3602A Full HD DVB-S2 + DVB-T combo receiver.

Uses the external Lemontree EuP standby and PT6311 8-character 14-segment VFD front-panel microcontroller at I2C 0x28 on GPIO 62 / 171 (CRC-16/XMODEM protocol), an ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33, and an Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60.
